explanation: Retrospective detector with two sources of drive. (A) Local two-token units that fire in any register, including third-person news prose: the last suffix piece of a word the tokenizer splits (Efferves|cent, Fires|ide, pharmac|ist, prot|racted, unwield|y; 0.45-1.0 of max), a number word straight after 'the'/'these' ('the three paintings'; 0.3-0.5, but bare 'three paintings', 'all three' and digits stay below 0.2), 'more' straight after 'some'/'one' (0.4-0.6), and pronoun 'one' after 'another'/'have'/'don't have'/'the red' (0.3-0.75). (B) In first/second-person, dialogue, request or instruction text (subject I/you/we/they/it/there, 'Can you', imperatives), many tokens reach 0.3-0.6: the copula after 'It'/'There'/'I' ('It was', 'There is', 'I am'), 'don' in 'don't', object 'you'/'it' after a verb ('I saw you', 'They gave it', 'thank you'), and an operand after an imperative verb ('take', 'add 3'). Predicted inactive (below about 0.2): third-person narrative or news whose clauses have full noun-phrase subjects and none of the (A) units, even when it contains 'more', 'you', 'it', 'them', 'interest' or numbers in other slots ('The farmer sold you a cow', 'hired more workers', 'bought three paintings', 'lacked interest', 'That was a cold night', 'The council approved the budget').
